units.locator: Article 23.11. Military Commissariats
units.text: 3) heads of divisions of military commissariats of municipal entities.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.11

units.locator: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions
units.text: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions
units.label: Art. 23.12

units.locator: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions
units.label: Art. 23.12

units.locator: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision of compliance with labour legislation and other regulatory legal acts containing labour law provisions shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1, 3, 4 and 6 of Article 5.27, parts 1 - 4 of Article 5.27.1, Articles 5.27.2 and 5.28 - 5.34, part 1 of Article 14.54, part 2 of Article 15.33.2, and Article 15.34 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.12

units.locator: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.12

units.locator: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions
units.text: 1) the Chief State Labour Inspector of the Russian Federation and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.12

units.locator: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision of compliance with labour legislation and other regulatory legal acts containing labour law provisions — chief state labour inspectors — and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.12

units.locator: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions
units.text: 3) chief state labour inspectors in constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their deputies;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.12

units.locator: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions
units.text: 4) heads of structural divisions of the respective state labour inspectorates — chief state labour inspectors — and their deputies;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.12

units.locator: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions
units.text: 5) chief state labour inspectors of the respective state labour inspectorates;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 23.12

units.locator: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions
units.text: 6) chief state labour inspectors;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 23.12

units.locator: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions
units.text: 7) senior state labour inspectors;
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 23.12

units.locator: Article 23.12. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision of Compliance with Labour Legislation and Other Regulatory Legal Acts Containing Labour Law Provisions
units.text: 8) state labour inspectors.
units.label: Point 8 Part 2 Art. 23.12

units.locator: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision
units.text: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision
units.label: Art. 23.13

units.locator: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision
units.label: Art. 23.13

units.locator: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision
units.text: 1. Authorities exercising federal state sanitary and epidemiological supervision shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 6.3, Articles 6.4 - 6.7, 6.24, 6.25 and 6.35, part 2 of Article 7.2 (with respect to the destruction of or damage to signs of sanitary (mining-sanitary) zones and districts, health-improvement localities and resorts), Article 8.5 (with respect to information on the condition of atmospheric air, sources of drinking and household water supply, and the radiation situation), parts 2, 3 and 4 of Article 8.42, parts 8 and 9 of Article 9.22, Article 10.8.1, parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, Articles 14.44 - 14.46, parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2, and parts 40 and 41 of Article 19.5 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.13

units.locator: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.13

units.locator: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision
units.text: 1) the Chief State Sanitary Physician of the Russian Federation and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.13

units.locator: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision
units.text: 2) chief state sanitary physicians for constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.13

units.locator: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision
units.text: 3) chief state sanitary physicians for cities, districts and transport and their deputies;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.13

units.locator: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision
units.text: 4) - 5) repealed. — Federal Law of 14.10.2014 No. 307-FZ;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.13

units.locator: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision
units.text: 6) chief state sanitary physicians of federal executive authorities in the sphere of activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, in the fields of internal affairs, defence, penal enforcement, mobilisation preparation and mobilisation, security, state protection, and the sanitary and epidemiological well-being of employees of organisations in certain industrial sectors with particularly hazardous working conditions and of the population of certain territories, and their deputies, and the chief state sanitary physician for facilities of the Administrative Directorate of the President of the Russian Federation and his or her deputies — concerning administrative offences committed in subordinate organisations and organisations served, as well as at subordinate facilities and facilities served and in territories served;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 23.13

units.locator: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision
units.text: 7) chief state sanitary physicians of territorial authorities of federal executive authorities in the sphere of activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, in the fields of internal affairs, defence, penal enforcement, security, state protection, and the sanitary and epidemiological well-being of employees of organisations in certain industrial sectors with particularly hazardous working conditions and of the population of certain territories, and their deputies — concerning administrative offences committed in subordinate organisations and organisations served, as well as at subordinate facilities and facilities served and in territories served.
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 23.13

units.locator: Article 23.13. Authorities Exercising Federal State Sanitary and Epidemiological Supervision
units.text: 3. Cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, Articles 14.44 - 14.46, and parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2 of this Code shall be heard by the officials specified in items 1 - 3 of part 2 of this Article.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 23.13

units.locator: Article 23.13.1. Authorities Exercising Control over the Release of Genetically Engineered Organisms into the Environment
units.text: Article 23.13.1. Authorities Exercising Control over the Release of Genetically Engineered Organisms into the Environment
units.label: Art. 23.13.1

units.locator: Article 23.13.1. Authorities Exercising Control over the Release of Genetically Engineered Organisms into the Environment
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.13.1. Authorities Exercising Control over the Release of Genetically Engineered Organisms into the Environment
units.label: Art. 23.13.1

units.locator: Article 23.13.1. Authorities Exercising Control over the Release of Genetically Engineered Organisms into the Environment
units.text: 1. Authorities exercising control over the release of genetically engineered organisms into the environment shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 6.3.1 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.13.1

units.locator: Article 23.13.1. Authorities Exercising Control over the Release of Genetically Engineered Organisms into the Environment
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.13.1

units.locator: Article 23.13.1. Authorities Exercising Control over the Release of Genetically Engineered Organisms into the Environment
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising control over the release of genetically engineered organisms into the environment and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.13.1

units.locator: Article 23.13.1. Authorities Exercising Control over the Release of Genetically Engineered Organisms into the Environment
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising control over the release of genetically engineered organisms into the environment and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.13.1

units.locator: Article 23.13.1. Authorities Exercising Control over the Release of Genetically Engineered Organisms into the Environment
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising control over the release of genetically engineered organisms into the environment and their deputies.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.13.1

units.locator: Article 23.14. Authorities Exercising Federal State Veterinary Supervision
units.text: Article 23.14. Authorities Exercising Federal State Veterinary Supervision
units.label: Art. 23.14

units.locator: Article 23.14. Authorities Exercising Federal State Veterinary Supervision
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.14. Authorities Exercising Federal State Veterinary Supervision
units.label: Art. 23.14

units.locator: Article 23.14. Authorities Exercising Federal State Veterinary Supervision
units.text: 1. Authorities exercising federal state veterinary supervision shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 2 and 3 of Article 8.52 (within their powers), Article 8.53 (within their powers), Articles 10.6 - 10.8.1, parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, Articles 14.44 - 14.46, parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2, and parts 8 and 8.1 of Article 19.5 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.14

units.locator: Article 23.14. Authorities Exercising Federal State Veterinary Supervision
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled, within their powers, to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.14

units.locator: Article 23.14. Authorities Exercising Federal State Veterinary Supervision
units.text: 1) the Chief State Veterinary Inspector of the Russian Federation and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.14

units.locator: Article 23.14. Authorities Exercising Federal State Veterinary Supervision
units.text: 2) chief state veterinary inspectors of the Russian Federation for constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.14

units.locator: Article 23.14. Authorities Exercising Federal State Veterinary Supervision
units.text: 3) - 4) repealed as of 1 January 2020. — Federal Law of 27.12.2019 No. 448-FZ;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.14

units.locator: Article 23.14. Authorities Exercising Federal State Veterinary Supervision
units.text: 5) chief state veterinary inspectors;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 23.14

units.locator: Article 23.14. Authorities Exercising Federal State Veterinary Supervision
units.text: 6) chief state veterinary inspectors of federal executive authorities in the field of defence, in the spheres of internal affairs, activities of the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, circulation of weapons, private security activities, extra-departmental security, enforcement of criminal penalties, state protection, and in the field of ensuring the security of the Russian Federation, and of their territorial authorities, and their deputies.
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 23.14

units.locator: Article 23.14.1. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Circulation of Medicinal Products for Veterinary Use
units.text: Article 23.14.1. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Circulation of Medicinal Products for Veterinary Use
units.label: Art. 23.14.1

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.14.1. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Circulation of Medicinal Products for Veterinary Use
units.label: Art. 23.14.1

units.locator: Article 23.14.1. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Circulation of Medicinal Products for Veterinary Use
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising state control (supervision) in the sphere of circulation of medicinal products for veterinary use and its territorial authorities shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1 and 4 of Article 14.4.2 of this Code (with respect to the circulation of medicinal products for veterinary use).
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.14.1

units.locator: Article 23.14.1. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Circulation of Medicinal Products for Veterinary Use
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.14.1

units.locator: Article 23.14.1. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Circulation of Medicinal Products for Veterinary Use
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising state control (supervision) in the sphere of circulation of medicinal products for veterinary use and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.14.1

units.locator: Article 23.14.1. Federal Executive Authority Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Sphere of Circulation of Medicinal Products for Veterinary Use
units.text: 2) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising state control (supervision) in the sphere of circulation of medicinal products for veterinary use and their deputies.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.14.1

units.locator: Article 23.15. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Quarantine Phytosanitary Supervision, State Supervision of the Safe Handling of Pesticides and Agrochemicals, and State Land Supervision (with Respect to the Use and Protection of Agricultural Land)
units.text: Article 23.15. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Quarantine Phytosanitary Supervision, State Supervision of the Safe Handling of Pesticides and Agrochemicals, and State Land Supervision (with Respect to the Use and Protection of Agricultural Land)
units.label: Art. 23.15

units.locator: Article 23.15. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Quarantine Phytosanitary Supervision, State Supervision of the Safe Handling of Pesticides and Agrochemicals, and State Land Supervision (with Respect to the Use and Protection of Agricultural Land)
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.15. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Quarantine Phytosanitary Supervision, State Supervision of the Safe Handling of Pesticides and Agrochemicals, and State Land Supervision (with Respect to the Use and Protection of Agricultural Land)
units.label: Art. 23.15

units.locator: Article 23.15. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Quarantine Phytosanitary Supervision, State Supervision of the Safe Handling of Pesticides and Agrochemicals, and State Land Supervision (with Respect to the Use and Protection of Agricultural Land)
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising federal state quarantine phytosanitary supervision, state supervision of the safe handling of pesticides and agrochemicals, and state land supervision (with respect to the use and protection of agricultural land whose turnover is regulated by Federal Law of 24 July 2002 No. 101-FZ 'On the Turnover of Agricultural Land', and land suitable for viticulture), and its territorial authorities shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 7.18, Article 8.3 (with respect to administrative offences involving violations of the rules for handling pesticides and agrochemicals during their storage and application), Article 8.6 (with respect to administrative offences committed in relation to agricultural land whose turnover is regulated by Federal Law of 24 July 2002 No. 101-FZ 'On the Turnover of Agricultural Land', and land suitable for viticulture), parts 1 and 2 of Article 8.7 (with respect to administrative offences committed in relation to agricultural land whose turnover is regulated by Federal Law of 24 July 2002 No. 101-FZ 'On the Turnover of Agricultural Land', and land suitable for viticulture), parts 2 and 2.1 of Article 8.8, Articles 10.1 - 10.3, Article 10.9, Article 10.10 (except navigational hydraulic structures), Articles 10.12 - 10.14, parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, Articles 14.44 - 14.46, and parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.15

units.locator: Article 23.15. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Quarantine Phytosanitary Supervision, State Supervision of the Safe Handling of Pesticides and Agrochemicals, and State Land Supervision (with Respect to the Use and Protection of Agricultural Land)
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.15

units.locator: Article 23.15. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Quarantine Phytosanitary Supervision, State Supervision of the Safe Handling of Pesticides and Agrochemicals, and State Land Supervision (with Respect to the Use and Protection of Agricultural Land)
units.text: 1) deputy heads of the federal executive authority exercising federal state quarantine phytosanitary supervision, state supervision of the safe handling of pesticides and agrochemicals, and state land supervision (with respect to the use and protection of agricultural land whose turnover is regulated by Federal Law of 24 July 2002 No. 101-FZ 'On the Turnover of Agricultural Land';
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.15

units.locator: Article 23.15. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Quarantine Phytosanitary Supervision, State Supervision of the Safe Handling of Pesticides and Agrochemicals, and State Land Supervision (with Respect to the Use and Protection of Agricultural Land)
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of that federal executive authority who are authorised to exercise federal state quarantine phytosanitary supervision, state supervision of the safe handling of pesticides and agrochemicals, and state land supervision (with respect to the use and protection of agricultural land whose turnover is regulated by Federal Law of 24 July 2002 No. 101-FZ 'On the Turnover of Agricultural Land'), and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.15

units.locator: Article 23.15. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Quarantine Phytosanitary Supervision, State Supervision of the Safe Handling of Pesticides and Agrochemicals, and State Land Supervision (with Respect to the Use and Protection of Agricultural Land)
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state quarantine phytosanitary supervision, state supervision of the safe handling of pesticides and agrochemicals, and state land supervision (with respect to the use and protection of agricultural land whose turnover is regulated by Federal Law of 24 July 2002 No. 101-FZ 'On the Turnover of Agricultural Land'), and their deputies;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.15

units.locator: Article 23.15. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Quarantine Phytosanitary Supervision, State Supervision of the Safe Handling of Pesticides and Agrochemicals, and State Land Supervision (with Respect to the Use and Protection of Agricultural Land)
units.text: 4) heads of structural divisions of those territorial authorities who are authorised to exercise federal state quarantine phytosanitary supervision, state supervision of the safe handling of pesticides and agrochemicals, and state land supervision (with respect to the use and protection of agricultural land whose turnover is regulated by Federal Law of 24 July 2002 No. 101-FZ 'On the Turnover of Agricultural Land'), and their deputies.
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.15

units.locator: Article 23.21. Authorities Exercising State Land Supervision
units.text: 1. Authorities exercising state land supervision (except the authority exercising state land supervision over agricultural land whose turnover is regulated by Federal Law of 24 July 2002 No. 101-FZ 'On the Turnover of Agricultural Land') shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 7.1 and 7.34, parts 1, 3 and 4 of Article 8.8, Article 10.9, and Article 10.10 (except navigational hydraulic structures and agricultural land) of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.21

units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
